cli.chat.ready.note: The Imp is waiting for you to write.

cli.chat.thinking.note: What the Imp is doing before the first words of its answer arrive.

cli.chat.thought_for.note: The collapsed line of what the Imp thought before it answered or used a tool. {seconds} is how long it took, in whole seconds.

cli.chat.answering.note: What the Imp is doing while its answer arrives.

cli.chat.using_tool.note: What the Imp is doing while it uses a tool.

cli.chat.input_hint.note: Faint hint in the empty message field.
cli.chat.input_hint.en: Write a message, / for commands, @ for files
cli.chat.input_hint.es: Escribe un mensaje, / para comandos, @ para archivos
cli.chat.input_hint.zh-Hans: 输入消息，/ 使用命令，@ 选择文件

cli.chat.input_wait.note: Faint hint in the message field while the Imp answers.

cli.chat.help_hint.note: Short reminder at the right of the status line that the question mark opens help.

cli.chat.tool_use.note: A line saying an Imp called a tool. {imp} is the Imp's name.

cli.chat.tool_result.note: The first line of what a tool returned.

cli.chat.error.note: A problem during an answer. {error} is a plain sentence.

cli.help.title.note: Title of the help card in the terminal chat.

cli.help.close.note: Last line of the help card.

cli.help.scroll_line.note: Help for Shift with the up and down arrows: scroll the chat.

cli.help.scroll_page.note: Help for Page Up and Page Down.

cli.help.key_wheel.note: Name of the mouse wheel in the list of keys.

cli.help.quit_empty.es: Sale si no hay nada escrito

cli.help.open.note: Help for the question mark key.
cli.help.open.en: Show this help when nothing is written
cli.help.open.es: Muestra esta ayuda si no hay nada escrito
cli.help.open.zh-Hans: 没有输入时显示此帮助

cli.help.key_status.note: Name of the status line in the list of what is on screen.

cli.help.imp.note: Help for the Imp's name and brain shown in the status line.
cli.help.imp.en: The Imp you talk to and its brain
cli.help.imp.es: El Imp con quien hablas y su cerebro
cli.help.imp.zh-Hans: 你在和哪个 Imp 说话，以及它的大脑

cli.help.you.note: Help for the arrow that starts what you wrote.

cli.help.activity.note: Help for the activity word in the status line.
cli.help.activity.en: What the Imp is doing now
cli.help.activity.es: Lo que hace el Imp ahora

cli.chat.welcome_hint.note: Shown under the Imp on an empty chat. Its name, model and folder are in the status line.
cli.chat.welcome_hint.en:
◦ / for commands such as /model
◦ @ to add a file such as @file.txt
◦ ? for every key
◦ Drag over text to copy it.
cli.chat.welcome_hint.es:
◦ / para comandos como /model y /mcp
◦ @ para añadir un archivo, como @file.txt
◦ ? para ver las teclas
◦ Arrastra sobre un texto para copiarlo.
cli.chat.welcome_hint.zh-Hans:
◦ / 使用 /model、/mcp 等命令
◦ @ 添加文件，如 @file.txt
◦ ? 查看所有按键
◦ 拖动选中文字即可复制。

cli.chat.running.note: Under a tool call whose result has not come yet.

cli.chat.waiting_for.note: Under a message to another Imp, before it answers. {imp} is its name.

cli.chat.away.note: Status line while the Imp is on another device. {device} is its name.

cli.chat.asleep.note: Status line while a visiting Imp's home device is not connected.

cli.help.stop_or_quit.en: Close the list, or stop an answer
cli.help.stop_or_quit.es: Cerrar la lista o detener una respuesta

cli.help.complete.note: What Tab and Right do while the list of / commands is open.

cli.help.tool.note: The marks of a tool call and of a message to another Imp in the chat.
cli.help.tool.en: A tool the Imp used, a message to another Imp, or what it thought
cli.help.tool.es: Una herramienta que usó el Imp, un mensaje a otro Imp, o lo que pensó
cli.help.tool.zh-Hans: Imp 使用的工具、发给另一个 Imp 的消息，或它的思考

cli.chat.menu_hint.note: Short reminder at the right of the status line while the list of / commands is open.
cli.chat.menu_hint.zh-Hans: ↑↓ 选择 · Tab 补全 · Esc 关闭

cli.help.line_ends.en: Start or end of the line
cli.help.line_ends.es: Inicio o final de la línea

cli.chat.scrolled_hint.note: Status line hint while the chat is scrolled up: End goes back to the latest lines.

cli.chat.copied.note: Said for a moment in the status line after text was copied.

cli.chat.attached.note: Under a message: the files picked with @ that went with it. {files} is a list of paths.

cli.chat.help_scroll.note: Last line of the help card when the screen is too short for all of it.
cli.chat.help_scroll.en: Up Down scroll, any other key closes
cli.chat.help_scroll.es: Arriba y abajo desplazan, otra tecla cierra
cli.chat.help_scroll.zh-Hans: 上下键滚动，其他键关闭

cli.chat.context_skills.note: On the empty chat, how many skills the folder has. {count} is a number.

cli.help.files.en: Add a file or folder to the message
cli.help.files.es: Añadir un archivo o carpeta al mensaje
cli.help.files.zh-Hans: 在消息中添加文件或文件夹

cli.help.key_drag.note: The word for dragging with the mouse, in the place of a key name.

cli.help.select.en: Choose text, copied when you let go
cli.help.select.es: Elegir texto, se copia al soltar

cli.help.key_double_click.note: The word for a double click, in the place of a key name.

cli.help.select_word.note: Help for double and triple clicks.
cli.help.select_word.en: Copy a word, or a paragraph with three clicks
cli.help.select_word.es: Copiar una palabra, o un párrafo con tres clics
cli.help.select_word.zh-Hans: 复制一个词，三击复制整段

cli.chat.stop_hint.note: After Thinking while the Imp works on an answer: the key that stops it.

cli.help.up_down.note: Help for Up and Down in the message field.
cli.help.up_down.en: Move between lines, then through what you sent
cli.help.up_down.es: Moverse entre líneas, luego por lo enviado
cli.help.up_down.zh-Hans: 在行间移动，再浏览已发送的内容

cli.help.tool_details.note: The key in the help card that opens the details of a tool call.
cli.help.tool_details.en: Open a tool call or a thought in full, with ← → between them
cli.help.tool_details.es: Abre una herramienta o un pensamiento completo, con ← → entre ellos
cli.help.tool_details.zh-Hans: 展开工具调用或思考的全文，用 ← → 切换

cli.chat.detail_result.note: Heading of a tool call's result in its details view.

cli.chat.detail_more.note: Last line of a long argument or result in the details view of a tool call. {count} is how many lines are hidden.
cli.chat.detail_more.zh-Hans: … 还有 {count} 行（按 Enter 显示全部）

cli.chat.detail_footer.note: Last line of the details view of a tool call or of a thought. {n} is which one this is and {total} how many there are.
cli.chat.detail_footer.zh-Hans: ← → 第 {n} 个，共 {total} 个 · ↑ ↓ 滚动 · Esc 关闭

cli.start.pick_title.note: Title of the list of Imps that opens when `imp` is run in a terminal and there are several.
cli.start.pick_title.en: Who do you want to talk to?

cli.start.pick_footer.note: Last line of the list of Imps.
cli.start.pick_footer.zh-Hans: ↑ ↓ 选择 · Enter 打开 · Esc 退出

cli.start.setup_title.note: Title of the first-run steps shown when `imp` is run in a terminal and there are no Imps yet.
cli.start.setup_title.en: Let's set up your first Imp
cli.start.setup_title.zh-Hans: 来设置你的第一个 Imp

cli.start.setup_service.note: Question of the first step: where the model runs. The choices are the saved services, then Remote and Local.

cli.start.setup_remote.note: Choice: a service on the internet that needs a key.
cli.start.setup_remote.en: Remote: an online service, needs a key
cli.start.setup_remote.es: Remoto: un servicio en línea, necesita una clave
cli.start.setup_remote.zh-Hans: 远程：在线服务，需要密钥

cli.start.setup_local.note: Choice: a model server on this computer.
cli.start.setup_local.en: Local: a model server on this computer
cli.start.setup_local.es: Local: un servidor de modelos en este equipo
cli.start.setup_local.zh-Hans: 本地：这台电脑上的模型服务

cli.start.setup_address.note: Question: the address of the service. It is filled in and can be changed.

cli.start.setup_key.note: Question: the key of the service. What is typed is hidden.

cli.start.setup_key_optional.note: Hint under the key question when the service runs on this computer.
cli.start.setup_key_optional.en: Not needed for local models. Enter skips it.
cli.start.setup_key_optional.es: No hace falta para modelos locales. Intro lo omite.
cli.start.setup_key_optional.zh-Hans: 本地模型不需要。按 Enter 跳过。

cli.start.setup_model.note: Question: the model. The field searches the list, and what is typed is used when nothing in the list matches.

cli.start.setup_models_loading.note: Shown while the models of the service are being asked for.

cli.start.setup_models_none.note: Hint under the model question when the service gave no list of models.
cli.start.setup_models_none.en: This service did not list its models. Type the name of one.
cli.start.setup_models_none.es: Este servicio no listó sus modelos. Escribe el nombre de uno.
cli.start.setup_models_none.zh-Hans: 此服务没有列出模型。请输入模型名。

cli.start.setup_name.note: Question: the name of the new Imp.
cli.start.setup_name.zh-Hans: 给你的 Imp 起个名字

cli.start.setup_footer_list.note: Last line of a step that is a list.
cli.start.setup_footer_list.zh-Hans: ↑ ↓ 选择 · Enter 下一步 · Esc 返回

cli.start.setup_footer_field.note: Last line of a step that is a field.
cli.start.setup_footer_field.zh-Hans: Enter 下一步 · Esc 返回

cli.start.setup_error_address.note: Problem with the address: it does not start with http:// or https://.
cli.start.setup_error_address.en: Write an address that starts with http:// or https://.
cli.start.setup_error_address.es: Escribe una dirección que empiece por http:// o https://.
cli.start.setup_error_address.zh-Hans: 请输入以 http:// 或 https:// 开头的地址。

cli.start.setup_error_key.note: Problem with the key: it is empty.
cli.start.setup_error_key.zh-Hans: 请粘贴你的密钥后再继续。

cli.start.setup_error_model.note: Problem with the model: it is empty or not a model name.
cli.start.setup_error_model.en: Choose a model or type its name.
cli.start.setup_error_model.es: Elige un modelo o escribe su nombre.
cli.start.setup_error_model.zh-Hans: 请选择模型或输入模型名。

cli.start.setup_error_name.note: Problem with the name of the Imp.
cli.start.setup_error_name.es: Usa de 1 a 32 letras, dígitos, - y _.
cli.start.setup_error_name.zh-Hans: 请使用 1 到 32 个字母、数字、- 和 _。

cli.start.setup_error_taken.note: Problem with the name of the Imp: another one has it. {name} is the name.
cli.start.setup_error_taken.en: There is already an Imp called {name}.
cli.start.setup_error_taken.zh-Hans: 已经有一个叫 {name} 的 Imp。

cli.start.issue_working.note: First run, shown while the build's own service hands out a key.

cli.start.issue_retry.note: Question after the key could not be had. Y is the default.
cli.start.issue_retry.en: Could not get a key. Try again? [Y/n]
cli.start.issue_retry.es: No se pudo obtener una clave. ¿Reintentar? [S/n]

cli.start.issue_retry_wait.note: Question after the service asked to wait before the next key. Y is the default.
cli.start.issue_retry_wait.en: The service asks you to wait {seconds} seconds. Try again then? [Y/n]
cli.start.issue_retry_wait.es: El servicio pide esperar {seconds} segundos. ¿Reintentar entonces? [S/n]
cli.start.issue_retry_wait.zh-Hans: 服务要求等待 {seconds} 秒。到时重试吗？[Y/n]
